claims.text: Fuinur seems to be a Sindarin name. Christopher Tolkien suggests that the initial element of this name is S. fuin ("night", "gloom", "darkness"), but the meaning of the suffix is unclear.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), The Silmarillion, "Appendix: Elements in Quenya and Sindarin Names", entry fuin
